svg.title: SemiAdder Pauli-product-measurement decomposition for three-bit registers
svg.desc: Native PennyLane circuit diagrams, continued from top to bottom. Each line represents a single qubit. Wires absent from a panel are unchanged. Both outcomes of every measurement-dependent branch are shown, with classical wires connecting measurements to their conditional operations. Dashed frames enclose conditional measurements. All work qubits start and finish in zero.
